purpose: Builds a target-weight bond ladder from a total notional split across maturity rungs and reports rung-by-rung and portfolio risk analytics: each rung's price, Macaulay and modified duration, DV01 and convexity (the same formulas as compute_bond_duration, compute_dv01 and compute_convexity applied at each rung's notional), plus the target_weight-weighted portfolio aggregates. Every reinvestment assumption is named in plain sentences in the output: hold_to_maturity (cash held at 0%) or roll_to_longest_rung (coupons and maturing principal reinvested at the longest rung's yield), and rung target weights must sum to 1 within 1e-9 or the tool refuses, naming the sum. Exclusions: no credit spread, no call features, flat yield per rung, no live data.
